name: green-alchemist
note: Coordinates are MESH-LOCAL, not world: mergeGeometry reads POSITION straight
off the primitive and never applies the node transform, and this model's node
carries scale 0.9474. Numbers read off render_ortho.py (which renders world
space) therefore come out ~5.6% small here and have to be divided by that
scale. Measured directly off the primitive: 1.617 tall, feet at y=-0.809,
T-pose arms outstretched to x=+-1.0, z spans +-0.356.
Unlike every other rig here the source is a clean T-pose, so the arms run
along X rather than hanging down: armX_upper and armX_fore are horizontal
bones, and alchemistPose.ts has to rotate a resting arm down about Z itself.
The character faces +Z, so its right hand is on -X. The head juts forward to
z~0.2 well ahead of the spine, the still apparatus hangs off the back at
z=-0.356, and the vial harness sits on the chest at z=+0.356.
Each bone is the segment from `pos` to `tip`; triangles are assigned to
the nearest bone, with `radius` biasing which bone wins contested mass

joints.comment: Root, and the bone that owns the apron. It runs DOWN from the belt to the hem rather than up like a normal pelvis, because the skirt is one closed shell from y=0.01 to y=-0.485 that the thighs would otherwise tear in half.
joints.name: hips

joints.comment: Greedy, and long: it holds the still hanging off the back at z=-0.356, which is further from the spine than anything else on the model and would otherwise fragment across the arms.
joints.name: torso

joints.comment: Pivots at the neck (y=0.69), which is where a head turn should hinge, and stays slim (radius 1.0) so it does not reach back and claim the pack. The jaw juts forward and DOWN past this pivot; the override below is what gives it back.
joints.name: head

joints.comment: Legs pivot at the hem, not at the pelvis: everything above y=-0.485 is apron, so a thigh rooted any higher claims skirt. The visible leg really is only the bottom fifth of the model.
joints.name: legR_thigh

overrides.comment: The head's jaw juts forward to z=0.34 and hangs down to y=0.54, well below the neck pivot at 0.69, so distance sliced the face in half and left the chin welded to the torso. Nothing else on the model reaches past z=0.24 inside |x|<0.14 at this height — the chest front stops at z=0.217 — so the box catches the jaw and only the jaw.

The apron's lower corners sit closer to a thigh bone than to the hips bone running down the centre line, so distance alone gave each thigh a wedge of skirt reaching up to y=-0.32 — and the skirt then flapped with the legs. This band is solid apron and nothing else (the legs do not separate until y=-0.5), so force all of it onto hips.
